+package config
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+)
+
+const (
+	// RedHat is the Red Hat Enterprise Linux OS family.
+	RedHat = "redhat"
+	// Debian is the Debian OS family.
+	Debian = "debian"

+	// Pseudo is the pseudo OS family used for synthetic targets.
+	Pseudo = "pseudo"

+	ServerTypePseudo = Pseudo
+)
+
+// EOL contains the standard and extended support end dates for an OS release.
+// Ended reports whether all modeled support phases have ended as of lookup time.
+type EOL struct {
+	StandardSupportUntil time.Time
+	ExtendedSupportUntil time.Time
+	Ended                bool
+}
+
+// IsStandardSupportEnded reports whether standard support ended strictly before now.
+func (e EOL) IsStandardSupportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.StandardSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.StandardSupportUntil)
+}
+
+// IsExtendedSupportEnded reports whether extended support ended strictly before now.
+func (e EOL) IsExtendedSupportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.ExtendedSupportUntil)
+}
+
+// IsExtendedSuppportEnded is retained with the spelling used by the public EOL interface.
+func (e EOL) IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return e.IsExtendedSupportEnded(now)
+}
+
+func eolDate(date string) time.Time {
+	parsed, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date)
+	return parsed
+}
+
+var eolByFamily = map[string]map[string]EOL{
+	Amazon: {
+		"2018.03":   {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2023-06-30"), ExtendedSupportUntil: eolDate("2023-06-30")},
+		"2 (Karoo)": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2025-06-30")},
+	},
+	RedHat: {
+		"7": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2024-06-30")},
+		"8": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2029-05-31")},
+		"6": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2020-11-30"), ExtendedSupportUntil: eolDate("2024-06-30")},
+	},
+	CentOS: {

+		"8": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2021-12-31")},
+		"6": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2020-11-30"), ExtendedSupportUntil: eolDate("2020-11-30")},
+	},
+	Oracle: {
+		"7": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2024-06-30")},
+		"8": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2029-05-31")},
+		"6": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2021-03-31"), ExtendedSupportUntil: eolDate("2022-03-31")},
+	},
+	Ubuntu: {
+		"18.04": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2023-05-31"), ExtendedSupportUntil: eolDate("2028-04-30")},
+		"14.04": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2019-04-30"), ExtendedSupportUntil: eolDate("2024-04-30")},
+		"14.10": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2015-07-30"), ExtendedSupportUntil: eolDate("2015-07-30")},
+		"21.04": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2022-01-30")},
+	},
+	Debian: {
+		"9":  {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2022-06-30")},
+		"10": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2024-06-30")},
+		"8":  {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2020-06-30"), ExtendedSupportUntil: eolDate("2020-06-30")},
+	},
+	Alpine: {
+		"3.10": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2021-05-30")},
+		"3.11": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2021-11-30")},
+		"3.12": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2022-05-30")},
+		"3.9":  {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2020-11-30"), ExtendedSupportUntil: eolDate("2020-11-30")},
+	},
+	FreeBSD: {
+		"11": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2021-09-30"), ExtendedSupportUntil: eolDate("2021-09-30")},
+		"12": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2023-12-31")},
+		"10": {StandardSupportUntil: eolDate("2019-10-30"), ExtendedSupportUntil: eolDate("2019-10-30")},
+	},
+}
+
+// GetEOL returns lifecycle data for a modeled family and release.
+func GetEOL(family string, release string) (EOL, bool) {
+	canonicalRelease := release
+	if family == Amazon {
+		// /etc/system-release has appeared as both "2 (Karoo)" and
+		// "2.0 (Karoo)". They refer to the same Amazon Linux 2 release.
+		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(release), "2.0 (Karoo)") {
+			canonicalRelease = "2 (Karoo)"
+		}
+	}
+
+	eol, found := eolByFamily[family][canonicalRelease]
+	if !found {
+		return EOL{}, false
+	}
+	lastSupportUntil := eol.StandardSupportUntil
+	if !eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() {
+		lastSupportUntil = eol.ExtendedSupportUntil
+	}
+	eol.Ended = time.Now().After(lastSupportUntil)
+	return eol, true
+}
+
+// EOLWarnings returns lifecycle guidance in evaluation order for one OS target.
+func EOLWarnings(family, release string, now time.Time) []string {
+	if family == Pseudo || family == Raspbian {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	eol, found := GetEOL(family, release)
+	if !found {
+		return []string{fmt.Sprintf(
+			"Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: %s Release: %s'",
+			family, release,
+		)}
+	}
+
+	if eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(now) {
+		warnings := []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended."}
+		if !eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() {
+			if eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now) {
+				warnings = append(warnings, "Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended.")
+			} else {
+				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
+					"Extended support available until %s. Check the vendor site.",
+					eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02"),
+				))
+			}
+		}
+		return warnings
+	}
+
+	if now.Before(eol.StandardSupportUntil) && !eol.StandardSupportUntil.After(now.AddDate(0, 3, 0)) {
+		return []string{fmt.Sprintf(
+			"Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: %s",
+			eol.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02"),
+		)}
+	}
+	return nil
+}

diff --git a/version/version.go b/version/version.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d8ab66c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/version/version.go
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+// Package version provides dependency-free version string helpers.
+package version
+
+import "strings"
+
+// Major returns the major version component, dropping an optional epoch prefix.
+// For example, "0:4.1" becomes "4" and "4.1" becomes "4".
+func Major(version string) string {
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(version, ':'); i >= 0 {
+		version = version[i+1:]
+	}
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(version, '.'); i >= 0 {
+		return version[:i]
+	}
+	return version
+}
